lead_raw_text:
The structure of Pr2Mg12Sn2 (PrMg6Sn) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: each Mg, Pr, and Sn atom has 12 geometric neighbors, with Mg surrounded by 8 Mg, 2 Pr, and 2 Sn neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations show Mg–Mg 12-vertex coordination polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, while Pr–Mg polyhedra share corners and edges.
